examNameMr: महाराष्ट्र कृषी सेवा, गट-अ व गट-ब (पूर्व व मुख्य) परीक्षा
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: Principles of Agronomy: Definition, Scope, and role of Agronomist in agriculture.
Classification of Crops: Agriculture seasons in India and in Maharashtra. Factors affecting crop production.
Tillage: Factors affecting tillage, type of tillage operations, tillage implements. Effects of tillage on soil and crop growth. Modern concepts of tillage.
Seed: Qualities of good seed, types of seed, seed testing and seed treatment, different methods of sowing, optimum plant population and geometry. Classification of Seeds.
Cropping systems: Types of cropping systems, crop rotations, relay cropping.
Weeds: Definition, methods of weed control, integrated weed management concept.
Definition of meteorology, weather and climate elements of weather.
Temperature measurement, factors affecting temperature.
Solar radiation, significance of solar radiation in agriculture, factors affecting solar radiation, measurement of solar radiation.
Atmosphere pressure its measurement, variation of pressure with height, hydrological cycle.
Drought climatology, classification of draught, weather forecasting in agriculture, its classification, techniques of weather forecasting, forecasting network in India.
Soil water: Sources of water, absorption and movement of water in soil, soil moisture constants, forms of soil water, factors affecting available soil moisture.
Absorption of soil moisture by plant, factors affecting absorption, evaporation, transpiration, consumptive use and effective rainfall.
Irrigation: Water requirement, irrigation requirement of crops, factors affecting water requirement, scheduling of irrigation - different approaches.
Depth of irrigation, measurement of irrigation, water use efficiency.
Drainage: Importance of drainage, types of drainage, effect of bad drainage on soil and crop growth.

Kharif crops including forages, cereals, millets and pulses: Cereals and Millets (Rice, Sorghum, Pearl millet, Maize, Hill millets), Pulses (Red gram, Greengram, Blackgram, Horsegram, Cowpea, Kidney bean and Dolichos), Oilseeds (Groundnut, sesame, soybean, Castor, Sunflower, Niger), Fibre crops (Cotton and Sannhemp), Commercial crops (Turmeric and ginger), Forage crops (Cowpea, Maize, Jowar, Napier, Rhodes, Paragrass, Subabhul, Shevari, stylo, Cluster bean, Marvel, Dinanath, Anjan), Green manuring crops (Sannhemp, Dhaincha, Glyricedia).

Rabi crops including forages, oilseeds and commercial crops: Cereals (Wheat, Rabi Sorghum), Pulses (Gram and Pea), Oilseeds (Linseed, Rapeseed mustard, safflower, sunflower), Commercial crops (Sugarcane, sugarbeat, potato), Forage crops (Lucern, Berseem, Oat, Summer maize, Summer sorghum), Summer crops (Rice, Groundnut, Greengram).

Rainfed Agriculture: Agroclimatic zones of Maharashtra, Techniques of soil and water conservation, moisture conservation, crop residue management, mulches, minimum tillage, zero tillage, harvesting and recycling of runoff water, Drought resistant crops, contingency planning.
Farming System and Sustainable Agriculture: Definition, sustainable agriculture, resource management, components of farming system, Effect of preceding and associated crops.
Definition of Soil, Weathering of rocks and minerals, physical and chemical properties of soil.
Soil structure, definition, types and its importance in crop production.
Soil texture, classes, ion exchange, soil solution, organic matter, soil moisture, Alkaline and Acid soils.
Quality of irrigation water, soil survey, Soil fertility and soil productivity.
Soil water movement, infiltration, percolation, evaporation and evapo-transpiration.
Essential plant nutrients, organic manures, fertilizers, Integrated Nutrient Management.

Eco-friendly farming, Nutrient management in problem soils, preparation of compost, vermicompost, Organic farming, Mixed, Complex and Compound fertilizers, micro nutrients, liquid fertilizers, Bio-fertilizer, Soil pollution by agro-chemicals.
Farm Machinery and Power: Sources of Farm Power, I.C. engines, Tractors, Tillage implements, Seed cum fertilizer drills, planters, chaff cutters, harvesters, threshers, plant protection equipment.

Agricultural Process Engineering: Food grain storage structures, pre-cooling, freezing, refrigeration, cold storage, drying, pasteurization, sterilization, evaporation, processing equipments, material handling equipments.
Soil and Water Conservation, Watershed Management: Principles of watershed management, surveying, leveling, watershed characteristics, soil and water conservation structures, erosion control.
Micro Irrigation and Drainage Engineering: Definition and Concept of micro-irrigation, design, pump selection, drainage systems.
Farm Structures: Building materials, farmstead location, dairy and poultry houses, farm fencing, greenhouse technology.
Morphology, Anatomy, Cytogenetics, Genetics, Plant Breeding, Plant Physiology, Social forestry, Medicinal and Aromatic plants, Environmental Science & Agro-ecology, Plant Biotechnology.
Entomology: General morphology, anatomy, physiology, classification, economic importance of insects, pest management, beneficial insects.
Plant Pathology: History, economic importance of plant diseases, fungi, bacteria, viruses, mycoplasma, disease control measures.
Cultivation of fruits, vegetables, flowers, plant growth regulators, post harvest management and processing.
Rural Sociology and Community Development, Principles of Extension Education and Educational Psychology, Extension teaching methods and aids, Extension Administration and Programme Evaluation.
Economics, Agricultural Economics, Agricultural Marketing, Agricultural credit, Farm management and production economics.
Animal Husbandry: Breeds, Farming & Management, Breeding, Reproduction, Nutrition.
Dairying: Milk and milk product, Legal standard and quality control tests.
Principles and methods of food preservation, raw material in food processing, industrial processing, quality control, food packaging.
Farm Power, Agricultural Tractors, Tillage Machinery, Planting and Harvesting Machinery, Plant Protection Appliances.
Drying of Farm Crops, Handling of Agricultural Materials, Processing of Agricultural & Horticultural Products, Dairy and Food Engineering.
Electricity, Solar Energy, Wind Energy, Biomass Energy.
Engineering Properties of materials of construction, foundation design, walls, roofs, flooring, doors, windows, farm roads, fences, greenhouse.
Hydrology, Sedimentation, Soil Erosion, Watershed Management.
Fluid Mechanics, Irrigation Methods, Canal Irrigation, Drainage Engineering, Ground Water Hydrology, Land Development.

importantNotes: Candidates must appear for both Preliminary and Main examinations as applicable for Group-A and Group-B services.
